about.title: About me
about.description: Fullstack developer, mountain enthusiast and multilingual problem solver.
about.hero_tagline: Fullstack developer building digital platforms for Scandinavian businesses — from the Swedish mountains.
about.story_p1: I'm a Dutch developer who moved to Ljungdalen, Sweden — a remote mountain village in Jämtland. Living here means I work closely with the kind of businesses I build for: tourism operators, cabin owners, and local service providers who need real digital infrastructure, not just a template.
about.story_p2: I build fullstack platforms that are EU-first by design: hosted on European infrastructure, GDPR-compliant, and built with technologies that last. Whether it's a booking system, a SaaS product or a client website — I take it from zero to production.
about.focus_1_body: Hetzner, Aiven, Bunny CDN — full EU infrastructure as default. GDPR-compliant from day one.
about.focus_2_body: Booking flows, cabin management, multi-role dashboards. Built for the industry I live in.
about.focus_3_body: Claude API for proposals, PR reviews and content generation. Practical AI, not hype.
about.focus_4_body: Design, development, deployment and domain — I deliver the full package, solo or in a team.
about.cta_body: I'm available for freelance work. Let's talk about what you need.
